field_descriptions.associated_anatomy: The anatomy of the underlying organ system or structures associated with this entity.
field_descriptions.cause: The cause of a medical condition.
field_descriptions.differential_diagnosis: One of a set of differential diagnoses for the condition. Specifically, a closely-related or competing diagnosis typically considered later in the cognitive process whereby this medical condition is distinguished from others most likely responsible for a similar collection of signs and symptoms to reach the most parsimonious diagnosis or diagnoses in a patient.
field_descriptions.drug: Specifying a drug or medicine used in a medication procedure.
field_descriptions.epidemiology: The characteristics of associated patients, such as age, gender, race etc.
field_descriptions.expected_prognosis: The likely outcome in either the short term or long term of the medical condition.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.natural_progression: The expected progression of the condition if it is not treated and allowed to progress naturally.
field_descriptions.pathophysiology: Changes in the normal mechanical, physical, and biochemical functions that are associated with this activity or condition.
field_descriptions.possible_complication: A possible unexpected and unfavorable evolution of a medical condition. Complications may include worsening of the signs or symptoms of the disease, extension of the condition to other organ systems, etc.
field_descriptions.possible_treatment: A possible treatment to address this condition, sign or symptom.
field_descriptions.primary_prevention: A preventative therapy used to prevent an initial occurrence of the medical condition, such as vaccination.
field_descriptions.risk_factor: A modifiable or non-modifiable factor that increases the risk of a patient contracting this condition, e.g. age,  coexisting condition.
field_descriptions.secondary_prevention: A preventative therapy used to prevent reoccurrence of the medical condition after an initial episode of the condition.
field_descriptions.sign_or_symptom: A sign or symptom of this condition. Signs are objective or physically observable manifestations of the medical condition while symptoms are the subjective experience of the medical condition.
field_descriptions.stage: The stage of the condition, if applicable.
field_descriptions.typical_test: A medical test typically performed given this condition.
